dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Yayoi Lacquerware — we sell only the best.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: If you want the best lacquerware in Inazuma, this is the place to be.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: We sell only the highest-quality items. Even big shots from the Shogunate order from us.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Our venerable store has been around for many years. I am the fourth generation owner and have inherited the pursuit of perfection from my ancestors.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Add that to the unique craftsmanship I learned from Sumeru, and I am sure that I will have much to add to our legacy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: May I use the Crafting Bench here?

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Be my guest, as long as you don't hinder my research. Use caution.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Good bye! The next time we meet, you shall behold my newest work.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: I once traveled to and studied at Sumeru Akademiya. The secret crafting techniques that I learned there has helped me create unique paints.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Lacquerware-making techniques are truly fascinating. My goal is to combine everything I have learned and become the best of the best.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: If my skill can reach that apex, I am sure that my lacquerware will bear out the pattern of the truth.
